title: Data-Driven Epistemic Arbitration and Cognitive OS Extensions
summary: Describes a proposed Epistemic Arbitration Layer for the Genius Cognitive System, extending the Requestor Node with GQHSM-driven reasoning frameworks, pluggable epistemologies, and structured arbitration traces.
notes: Contains illustrative technical sketches (JSON machine config example, callback registry, plugin ABI stub, trace output format) that resemble SPEC elements, but the document's primary character is explanatory architecture documentation — design rationale, principles, component relationships, and aspirational direction. No formal API contracts, SLOs, or protocol definitions. Previously classified as SPEC; reclassified as DOC because technical details serve illustrative rather than contractual purposes.
